helper.STANDARD_ITEM: A straightforward one-item listing with no extra structure.

adaptiveHelper.STANDARD_ITEM: Keep the flow lightweight and focus on the normal title, description, category, and condition fields.

adaptiveHelper.WISHLIST: Highlight what you want to receive so future matching and discovery stay useful.
